digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text sync (Cloud ADF + Data Center wiki)
propositions: Cloud descriptions and comments must encode Markdown as structured ADF through production codec paths without emitting plain-text paragraphs
Data Center descriptions and comments must render safe Markdown as native wiki markup through the production codec paths with fallback when pandoc is unavailable
Both Cloud and DC must suppress echo loops and concurrent-edit conflicts through baseline/local/remote three-way comparison while preserving Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates)
Idempotent Markdown↔ADF round-trip for Cloud and zero monotonic length decay over repeated DC passes must be achieved and sustained across committed fixture corpora
Append-only comment synchronization must persist local-comment-key to Jira-comment-ID mappings and mirror only newly created comments using the same rich-text codec as descriptions
Live DC harness must exercise production cutover against a live Jira DC instance, verify rendered HTML through expand=renderedFields, and confirm second reconcile pass performs no body update
